punchline: PayPal was born when two startups wearing each other out merged, and within months the merged company had a new CEO.
thirty_sec: In Palo Alto, Confinity and X.com chased the same customers and engineers, and both paid new users to join. They merged in March 2000. The fights over management and technology did not stop: in September the board replaced Musk as CEO with Thiel. The company became PayPal, and eBay bought it in 2002 for about $1.5 billion. Jimmy Soni tells it in The Founders.
